name: Sales CRM
description: A Pipedrive-style sales CRM: a drag-and-drop pipeline board with a per-stage value funnel, a leads inbox worked as a split view, deals with activities/notes/products/files, contacts and organizations, and an insights dashboard. Hand-authored reference app — the best Pipedrive clone expressible against today's runtime, with everything it cannot do recorded in CRM-GAPS.md.

archetype.coreJob: Move deals through the pipeline stages on a board and never miss the next activity on any open deal

entities.label: Deal
entities.description: An opportunity moving through the pipeline. Stage (where it is in the funnel) is independent of status (open/won/lost), exactly like Pipedrive.

fields.label: Stage
fields.help: Where the deal sits in the pipeline. Drag the card on the Pipeline board to change it.

fields.label: Status
fields.help: Open deals live on the board; Won/Lost is decided with the header buttons, independent of stage.

fields.label: Probability %
fields.help: Kept in sync with the stage by workflows; set to 100/0 on win/loss.

fields.label: Weighted value
fields.help: Deal value x win probability - the honest forecast number.

fields.label: Next step
fields.help: The next concrete action that moves this deal.

fields.label: Follow up on
fields.help: When the next step is due — drives My Day.

entities.label: Activity
entities.description: A call, meeting, task or email that HAPPENED — the historic log of touches on a deal, person and organization. Planning the next move lives on the deal (next step + follow up on), not here.

entities.label: Lead
entities.description: An unqualified inbound/outbound prospect. Qualify it in the Leads inbox and convert it into a deal.

fields.label: Received
fields.help: When this lead came in — sorts the inbox and the leads list.

fields.label: Company (as given)
fields.help: What the enquiry called itself. Kept as typed: a lead arrives before anybody has decided it is worth a record, and the raw wording is evidence of where it came from.

fields.label: Organization
fields.help: The company record this lead was matched to. Optional on purpose - an unqualified enquiry has no organization yet, and forcing one would mean creating a company record for every scrap of inbound interest. Fill it in and the lead shows up on that company's page.

fields.label: Amount
fields.help: Line total. Enter quantity × unit price — the runtime has no computed fields yet.

columns.label: Pipeline funnel — open value by stage

commands.label: Convert to deal

confirm.title: Convert this lead into a deal?
confirm.message: A new deal is created in Lead In with this lead's title, value and owner. Link the organization and contact person on the deal afterwards.

commands.successMessage: Lead converted — the new deal is in the pipeline at Lead In.

roles.name: Sales Rep
roles.description: Works leads, deals and activities. Cannot delete records or manage the product catalog.

roles.name: Sales Manager
roles.description: Everything a rep can do, plus deletes and the product catalog.
